method.title: Methodology
method.conceptBody: Susceptibility is precomputed offline from terrain and never changes with the weather; the predictors used are listed in this file’s metadata and shown per cell in the inspector. Triggering is computed live in this browser from rainfall. The map shows the product of the two.
method.simulatedBody: The sensor node panel shows generated values, not readings from a deployed device. Field hardware is in development.
method.noMetadata: This grid file carries no metadata block, so generation details are unavailable. Regenerate it with the offline pipeline to embed them.
method.aucNote: The random split scores higher because neighbouring cells are not independent — a cell’s neighbours leak into the test fold. The spatial-block figure holds whole 0.5° blocks out, and is the honest one.
